description: List the codes of one directional diagnosis or procedure list from JGP attachment 9, one page at a time. Take list_id from conditions.lists[].id and catalog from group.catalog of a get_jgp_group answer, with the same service_date. For the groups that name a given code, use get_code instead.

catalog.description: Catalog that get_jgp_group names with the list.

service_date.description: Day of care, YYYY-MM-DD; picks the release in force. Default today in Poland.

name: get_jgp_list

outputSchema.description: A JGP or grouping answer of the HTTP API, with the notice.

title: JGP list
